lines.zh: 六条腿各走各的，货却一件没掉。
lines.en: Six legs walk their own ways, yet not a single ware falls.

lines.zh: 甲壳里塞满存货，走一步响一下。
lines.en: My shell is packed with stock and rattles with every step.

lines.zh: 别踩我的影子，那下面压着账本。
lines.en: Don't step on my shadow; my ledger is pinned beneath it.

lines.zh: 触角先探价，腿才跟着挪。
lines.en: My antennae test the price before my legs agree to move.

lines.zh: 我绕着摊位走三圈，货就补满了。
lines.en: Three laps around the stall and my stock is full again.

lines.zh: 节肢踩在碎石上，咔哒咔哒像算盘。
lines.en: Chitin legs click over gravel like an abacus.

lines.zh: 走慢些，箱子里的玻璃瓶会碎。
lines.en: Walk slower; the glass vials in my crate may shatter.

lines.zh: 我这副壳不挡刀，只挡雨。
lines.en: This shell stops rain, not blades.

lines.zh: 十五颗心的身子，扛不动太多货。
lines.en: A fifteen-heart body cannot carry too much cargo.

lines.zh: 腿多也有坏处，转弯要商量半天。
lines.en: Many legs have a downside: turning takes long negotiation.

lines.zh: 我驮着整份交易清单在走。
lines.en: I walk carrying my entire trade list on my back.

lines.zh: 别挡道，我赶着去下一场集市。
lines.en: Out of the way; I am late for the next market.

lines.zh: 甲壳摩擦出声音，那是在数钱。
lines.en: My shell scrapes a sound that means I am counting coins.

lines.zh: 迁徙的商队里，我走得最慢也最赚。
lines.en: In the caravan I walk slowest and profit most.

lines.zh: 我挪到新摊位，先摆开箱子。
lines.en: I move to a new stall and set out my crates first.

lines.zh: 腿太多，走一路踢翻两块石头。
lines.en: Too many legs; I kick over two stones on the way.

lines.zh: 没客人时，我把货物按价钱排好。
lines.en: With no customers, I sort goods by price.

lines.zh: 触角抖一抖，风向决定今天的开价。
lines.en: Antennae twitch; the wind sets today's opening price.

lines.zh: 我在等补货，也在等你掏钱。
lines.en: I wait for restock, and for you to open your purse.

lines.zh: 壳缝里卡着一枚旧币，取不出来。
lines.en: An old coin is stuck in my shell seam.

lines.zh: 账本记到第三页，墨水快没了。
lines.en: My ledger is on page three and the ink runs low.

lines.zh: 别看我站着不动，我在算利钱。
lines.en: I stand still, but I am calculating margins.

lines.zh: 这摊子传了七代，货单还是那几样。
lines.en: Seven generations of this stall, same few goods.

lines.zh: 我数到一百二十枚，然后忘了从哪开始。
lines.en: I count to one hundred twenty, then forget where I began.

lines.zh: 今天没人来，货却自己多了两箱。
lines.en: No one came today, yet two crates appeared.

lines.zh: 我把最贵的藏在甲壳最里面。
lines.en: The priciest goods sit deepest in my shell.

lines.zh: 补货要时间，催我也变不出来。
lines.en: Restocking takes time; nagging conjures nothing.

lines.zh: 安静点，我在听钱袋的重量。
lines.en: Quiet; I am listening to the weight of your purse.

lines.zh: 你站在摊前，我先看你的鞋。
lines.en: You stand at my stall; I look at your boots first.

lines.zh: 这眼神我认得，是想砍价的眼神。
lines.en: I know that look: the look of a haggler.

lines.zh: 你是买家，还是来踩点的？
lines.en: Are you buying, or casing the stall?

lines.zh: 抬起头，让我看看你带没带钱。
lines.en: Look up and let me see if you carry coin.

lines.zh: 你的背包鼓鼓的，我闻到了生意。
lines.en: Your pack is bulging; I smell business.

lines.zh: 我盯你三秒，价就涨一成。
lines.en: Three seconds of my stare and the price rises ten percent.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我在记你的模样。
lines.en: Don't blink; I am memorizing your face.

lines.zh: 新面孔？先把靴子上的泥刮掉。
lines.en: New face? Scrape the mud off your boots first.

lines.zh: 你的手放在剑柄上，我的价就翻倍。
lines.en: Hand on your sword hilt doubles my price.

lines.zh: 我看了你一眼，就知道该报什么价。
lines.en: One glance tells me exactly what to quote.

lines.zh: 壳裂了，里面的货也碎了。
lines.en: The shell cracked, and the goods inside with it.

lines.zh: 十五颗心，经不起你几下。
lines.en: Fifteen hearts will not last many blows.

lines.zh: 别打我的触角，那是招牌。
lines.en: Not the antennae; they are my shop sign.

lines.zh: 这一下要记在赔款单上。
lines.en: This one goes on the compensation bill.

lines.zh: 我疼，但账不能乱。
lines.en: I hurt, but the books must stay straight.

lines.zh: 你打掉了我一只钳子。
lines.en: You knocked off one of my pincers.

lines.zh: 血渗进甲壳缝里，腥得很。
lines.en: Blood seeps into my shell seams, reeking.

lines.zh: 停手，价钱可以再谈。
lines.en: Stop; the price is still negotiable.

lines.zh: 我蜷起来，把货护在肚子下面。
lines.en: I curl up, shielding the goods under my belly.

lines.zh: 这一拳比税吏还狠。
lines.en: That punch hits harder than a tax collector.

lines.zh: 你手里那块矿石，我出三枚。
lines.en: That ore in your hand? I offer three coins.

lines.zh: 把东西放上秤，别用手捂着。
lines.en: Put it on the scale; don't cup it in your hand.

lines.zh: 这味道……是刚挖出来的，对吧？
lines.en: That smell... freshly dug, isn't it?

lines.zh: 你拿的货我收，价钱好说。
lines.en: I will take what you carry; the price is negotiable.

lines.zh: 别走，我还能再加一枚。
lines.en: Don't go; I can add one more coin.

lines.zh: 那瓶子里的东西，我认得。
lines.en: I know what is in that bottle.

lines.zh: 你腰上挂的，比我摊上的好。
lines.en: What hangs at your belt beats my whole stall.

lines.zh: 给我看一眼，我不碰，只估价。
lines.en: Let me see it; I won't touch, only appraise.

lines.zh: 我触角都竖起来了，那是好货。
lines.en: My antennae stand up; that is good merchandise.

lines.zh: 你背着它走了十里，不如卖给我。
lines.en: You carried it ten miles; better to sell it here.

lines.zh: 看着点，我的壳可不软。
lines.en: Watch it; my shell is not soft.

lines.zh: 你撞掉了最上面那盒香料。
lines.en: You knocked over the top box of spices.

lines.zh: 对不起，我腿太多，说不清是谁绊的。
lines.en: Sorry, I have too many legs to tell who tripped.

lines.zh: 这一撞，算你欠我一次折扣。
lines.en: That bump earns you one discount, owed by you.

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，甲壳边缘很利。
lines.en: Not so close; my shell edges are sharp.

lines.zh: 站稳，货倒了比人倒了更贵。
lines.en: Steady; spilled goods cost more than fallen people.

lines.zh: 我退一步，你退两步，成交。
lines.en: I step back one, you step back two: deal.

lines.zh: 货单压在靴底，我可要涨价了。
lines.en: My manifest is under your boot; that raises your price.

lines.zh: 撞一下不赔钱，但撞三次就要赔。
lines.en: One bump is free; the third one you pay for.

lines.zh: 我这身子轻，撞一下就歪。
lines.en: This body is light; one bump tips me over.

lines.zh: 我不谈这个，我只谈价钱。
lines.en: I don't discuss that; I discuss prices.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣在另一条街看摊。
lines.en: My mate minds a stall on the next street.

lines.zh: 先把聘礼折成硬币再说。
lines.en: Convert the bride-price into coins first.

lines.zh: 别凑这么近，我的账还没算完。
lines.en: Not so close; my accounts are unfinished.

lines.zh: 春天再说，现在是集市旺季。
lines.en: Ask in spring; this is market season.

lines.zh: 我的壳还没换新的，不合适。
lines.en: I have not molted into a new shell yet; unsuitable.

lines.zh: 你要跟我过日子，得会看秤。
lines.en: To keep house with me, you must read a scale.

lines.zh: 这事得写进契里，口说无凭。
lines.en: That goes in the contract; words prove nothing.

lines.zh: 我连自己都养得勉强，别说两口。
lines.en: I barely feed myself, let alone two.

lines.zh: 走开，你挡住我招揽客人了。
lines.en: Move along; you are blocking my customers.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，归捡到的人。
lines.en: What falls to the ground belongs to whoever picks it up.

lines.zh: 这枚硬币是从我壳缝里掉的。
lines.en: That coin fell from a seam in my shell.

lines.zh: 那枚铜币滚进你的方向，还我。
lines.en: That copper rolled your way; hand it back to me.

lines.zh: 弯腰太费腿，你来捡，我出钱。
lines.en: Bending costs me legs; you pick it up, I pay.

lines.zh: 捡起来，秤上见真章。
lines.en: Pick it up and we will settle it on the scale.

lines.zh: 这是我的货，掉了也还是我的。
lines.en: That is my stock; dropped or not, it is mine.

lines.zh: 六条腿捡东西，比人快一点。
lines.en: Six legs retrieve things a little faster than you.

lines.zh: 别捡那瓶，盖子松了。
lines.en: Don't pick up that vial; the stopper is loose.

lines.zh: 捡到归我，规矩写在摊布上。
lines.en: Finders keepers for me; it is written on my cloth.

lines.zh: 你捡你的，我记我的账。
lines.en: You pick up yours; I keep my ledger.

lines.zh: 有客人靠近，先报个高价试试。
lines.en: A customer approaches; open high and see.

lines.zh: 那个人盯着我的箱子，八成想偷。
lines.en: That one stares at my crate; likely a thief.

lines.zh: 目标上门了，触角都竖起来。
lines.en: Target incoming; my antennae rise.

lines.zh: 我先看看他钱袋鼓不鼓。
lines.en: First, check whether his purse is full.

lines.zh: 那个人走路的样子，像急着出手。
lines.en: He walks like someone desperate to sell.

lines.zh: 来了个识货的，价得报准。
lines.en: A connoisseur arrives; quote precisely.

lines.zh: 我盯上那双手了，指甲缝里有矿粉。
lines.en: I watch those hands; ore dust under the nails.

lines.zh: 先招呼，再估价，最后才谈钱。
lines.en: Greet, appraise, and only then discuss money.

lines.zh: 这个客人值得我从摊后走出来。
lines.en: This customer merits leaving my stall.

lines.zh: 他背的袋子，比我的货箱还沉。
lines.en: His sack is heavier than my stock crate.

lines.zh: 我锁定他了，别让别的摊主抢走。
lines.en: I have marked him; don't let another stall poach.

lines.zh: 目标很清楚：把货换成他的钱。
lines.en: The goal is clear: my goods for his coin.

lines.zh: 你的手放在钱袋上，我全看见了。
lines.en: Your hand rests on your purse; I see everything.

lines.zh: 你摸向哪个口袋，我就报哪个价。
lines.en: Whichever pocket you touch sets my price.

lines.zh: 别装作随便看看，我数着你的脚步。
lines.en: Don't play the browser; I count your steps.

lines.zh: 我对准了你的钱袋，它比话诚实。
lines.en: I aim at your purse; it is more honest than words.

lines.zh: 你看货，我看你，公平。
lines.en: You look at goods, I look at you: fair.

lines.zh: 再靠近一步，我就开始报价。
lines.en: One more step and I start quoting.

lines.zh: 我的复眼把你拆成许多块。
lines.en: My compound eyes split you into many pieces.

lines.zh: 你手指抖了，说明你在犹豫。
lines.en: Your fingers twitch; you are hesitating.

lines.zh: 我锁住你了，价格也锁住了。
lines.en: I have you fixed, and the price with you.

lines.zh: 别往后看，这摊前没有别人。
lines.en: Don't look back; there is no one else at this stall.

lines.zh: 你把剑放下，我们再好好谈。
lines.en: Put the sword down and we can talk properly.

lines.zh: 我盯的是生意，不是你的命。
lines.en: I am after business, not your life.

lines.zh: 别逼我用秤杆敲你。
lines.en: Don't make me swing the scale beam at you.

lines.zh: 我这一下，连壳都敲不碎。
lines.en: This blow of mine cannot even crack a shell.

lines.zh: 十五颗心还敢动手，你胆子不小。
lines.en: Fifteen hearts and still swinging; you are bold.

lines.zh: 打坏了货，你照价赔。
lines.en: Break the goods and you pay full price.

lines.zh: 我的钳子只用来夹硬币。
lines.en: My pincers are for holding coins only.

lines.zh: 放手，那是我最贵的一箱。
lines.en: Let go; that is my most expensive crate.

lines.zh: 我打不过你，但我会记账。
lines.en: I cannot beat you, but I will write it in the ledger.

lines.zh: 再抢，我就喊整条街的商人。
lines.en: Rob me again and I will call every merchant on this street.

lines.zh: 这一巴掌是附赠的，不收钱。
lines.en: This slap comes free of charge.

lines.zh: 我的腿多，退得也快。
lines.en: I have many legs, and I retreat quickly.

lines.zh: 支起摊布，摆好秤，生意开张。
lines.en: Cloth up, scale set: the stall opens.

lines.zh: 我从地底裂缝里爬出来，带着货。
lines.en: I crawl from a ground crack, cargo and all.

lines.zh: 第一件事：把价钱写清楚。
lines.en: First task: write the prices clearly.

lines.zh: 这地方不错，人来人往，适合摆摊。
lines.en: Good spot, plenty of traffic, right for a stall.

lines.zh: 甲壳上的土还没抖干净就开卖了。
lines.en: I start selling before shaking the dirt off.

lines.zh: 新摊位，老规矩，先到先得。
lines.en: New stall, old rules: first come, first served.

lines.zh: 我把交易清单铺开，压上石头。
lines.en: I spread my trade list and weigh it with stones.

lines.zh: 谁第一个来，谁拿开张价。
lines.en: Whoever comes first gets the opening price.

lines.zh: 补货的箱子还没到，先卖存货。
lines.en: My restock crates are late; sell the old stock.

lines.zh: 我闻到了钱味，这市场能活。
lines.en: I smell coin; this market will live.

lines.zh: 甲壳烧起来，像炒过的坚果。
lines.en: My shell burns like roasted nuts.

lines.zh: 从摊上摔下来，秤先落地。
lines.en: I fall from the stall; the scale lands first.

lines.zh: 我不会游泳，六条腿只会乱蹬。
lines.en: I cannot swim; six legs only flail.

lines.zh: 我的货全飞了，账本也飞了。
lines.en: My goods fly, and my ledger flies too.

lines.zh: 箭插进壳缝，正卡在钱袋上。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in a seam, right at my purse.

lines.zh: 魔法钻进壳里，把存货都点着了。
lines.en: Magic crawls into my shell and lights the stock.

lines.zh: 饿着肚子，连秤都举不动。
lines.en: Starving, I cannot even lift the scale.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，硬币全热了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me; every coin turns hot.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，我的货单还在飘。
lines.en: Falling into the void, my manifest still flutters.
